Written non-atomically by marking (MarkPage: OutPageRequestFlags[addr]=Flags).
Cleared at frame start with AddClearPageTableUAVPass(...,0u) (VSMARRAY_C:2737-2738).
gaps: Only the request-bit meanings proven by MarkPage are asserted; prefiltered-distant/secondary-request marking site is not anchored in this step.
The capture byteSize includes mip0 only (8192x192x4 = 6291456).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint4 inclusive page rectangle per (shadow-map data index, mip level); 4 names are the current allocation, current uncached-render set, and their previous-frame copies
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: per shadow map, page space of the level: valid range [0, 128>>mipLevel)

transforms.name: rectLayout
transforms.expression: Index = VirtualShadowMap.GetDataIndex()*VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS + MipLevel; rect is inclusive (Min<=Max); empty rect = (128,128,0,0)

mathTerms: NumPageRects = GetNumShadowMapSlots() * VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS; allocation rounded up to a power of two (VSMARRAY_C:2796-2799).
Cleared to uint4(VSM_LEVEL0_DIM_PAGES_XY, VSM_LEVEL0_DIM_PAGES_XY, 0, 0) = (128,128,0,0) so InterlockedMin/Max are valid (InitPageRectBounds:129-131).
Allocated includes mapped+cached pages; Uncached/PageRectBounds only pages with VSM_FLAG_ANY_UNCACHED (GenerateHierarchicalPageFlags:203-210).
gaps: The capture distinguishes 131072 elements = 16384 slots x 8 mips; per-capture slot count is runtime data, not a schema constant.
PrevAllocatedPageRectBounds/PrevUncachedPageRectBounds are re-registered previous-frame buffers; their producer is the same pass in the prior frame.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 4 int32 lists, each MaxPhysicalPages entries followed by one int32 count; LRU, available, empty, requested
resourceSchemas.units: physical page linear index; trailing element is an element count
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical page pool linear index = y<<PhysicalPageRowShift + x (page, not texel)

formatAlternatives: items are int32; INDEX_NONE (-1) marks removed LRU slots

fields.name: ListItem
fields.decode: list[PageList][i] for i in [0,Count); value = physical page index or -1 in LRU holes

fields.name: ListCount
fields.decode: list[PageList][MaxPhysicalPages] = current count; per list base = PageList*(MaxPhysicalPages+1)

transforms.name: listBases
transforms.expression: base(PageList) = PageList*(MaxPhysicalPages+1); indices 0..3 = LRU, AVAILABLE, EMPTY, REQUESTED

mathTerms: PUSH at the tail via atomic count increment; POP from the tail (count-1). Overflow is prevented by refusing pushes at count==MaxPhysicalPages (PushPhysicalPageList:71-87, PopPhysicalPageList:90-105).

mathTerms: 4 bits per light; 8 lights per dword; max 32 lights across uint4 (LightGridCommon.ush:240-269).
OutShadowMaskBits is written as uint4 (VirtualShadowMapProjection.usf:259,1040) but the texture format truncates to the selected dword count.
Dither variant adds (Dither-0.5)/16 to fractional values (LightGridCommon.ush:272-280).

resourceSchemas.quantity: single uint32 bump-allocator cursor for CulledLightDataGrid slots (light entries plus reflection-capture entries)

fields.name: Allocator
fields.decode: cleared to 0 before injection; InterlockedAdd(Allocator[0], NumVisibleLights) returns the pre-add base

transforms.name: base
transforms.expression: base = InterlockedAdd(Allocator[0], Count)  // pre-add value; first allocation = 0

mathTerms: Capacity is NumCulledLightEntries = MaxNumCells*GMaxCulledLightsPerCell (573440 in capture); there is no bounds check, overflow is detected by FeedbackStatus afterwards.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 16-bit (or 32-bit) local-light index per culled-light slot; lights occupy [cell*MaxCulledLightsPerCell..+count) and reflection captures the second half
resourceSchemas.units: local light index into ForwardLightBuffer (reflection cells: reflection-capture index)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none (index list); cell base and count come from NumCulledLightsGrid headers

formatAlternatives: PF_R16_UINT unstructured buffer when LightGridUses16BitBuffers(); uint32 structured buffer otherwise

fields.name: Entry
fields.decode: GetCulledLightDataGrid(i) = CulledLightDataGrid16Bit[i]; value is a forward-light index, not an offset

transforms.name: slotAccess
transforms.expression: linked-list: start=header1.DataStartIndex & 0x3FFFFFFF, light j at start+j; fixed-slot: light cell k at k*MaxCulledLightsPerCell + j

mathTerms: MaxCulledLightsPerCell=32 (GMaxCulledLightsPerCell), NumCulledLightEntries = MaxNumCells*32.
No sentinel: uint16 0..65535 are all valid light indices; >65536 lights truncates and warns (LightGridInjection.cpp:1735-1743).

gaps: 16-bit vs 32-bit is a platform permutation decided by RHISupportsBufferLoadTypeConversion and mobile; the capture proves the 16-bit path.

resourceSchemas.quantity: single uint32 bump-allocator cursor for link records in CulledLightLinks

formatAlternatives: one per view; cleared after grid setup

fields.name: LinkAllocator
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd(LinkAllocator[0],1) returns the pre-add link index; first link = 0

mathTerms: Write is guarded by NextLink < NumAvailableLinks; capacity = MaxNumCells*GMaxCulledLightsPerCell (573440 links in capture), capped at 1<<24 for thread-group-per-cell.
Only populated when USE_LINKED_CULL_LIST.
gaps: Overflow drops link writes silently (grid loses lights) and only warns.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 8-byte link record per culled-link allocation; two mutually exclusive encodings selected by the USE_THREAD_GROUP_PER_CELL permutation
resourceSchemas.units: encoding A: local light index + previous link offset; encoding B: 24-bit primitive index + 16-bit index-in-cell + 24-bit next link offset
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none (link chain); terminator differs per encoding

fields.name: LinkWord1
fields.decode: encoding A: previous LinkOffset, 0xFFFFFFFF = end; encoding B: ((IndexInCell>>8)&0xFF)<<24 | (LinkOffset & 0xFFFFFF), 0xFFFFFF = end

mathTerms: Encoding A terminates at 0xFFFFFFFF; encoding B terminates at LIGHT_GRID_CELL_WRITER_MAX_LINK_OFFSET = 0xFFFFFF.
Off-by-one: when NumAvailableLinks == 1<<24, link index 0xFFFFFF is allocatable but indistinguishable from encoding B's sentinel; that final slot is effectively unusable (dormant at capture scale).
gaps: The two encodings are not interchangeable; the consumer must match the writer permutation (USE_THREAD_GROUP_PER_CELL).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one index per directional light: the light's ForwardLightBuffer slot
mathTerms: NumDirectionalLights = DirectionalLightIndices.Num() (LightGridInjection.cpp:1717); every element is valid.

resourceSchemas.quantity: dummy path: a single 4-byte dword; real path uses 16 dwords (64 B) per light and is named LightNamesBuffer
resourceSchemas.units: raw dword(s) of packed character/name data

fields.name: DummyDword
fields.decode: 4-byte default byte-address buffer; contents are not a light name

gaps: Only the dummy-path record is described; the real 64-byte light-name record's character packing is not decoded.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 96-byte FForwardLightData record per forward light (6 float4 elements)
resourceSchemas.units: mixed: translated-world position (cm), 1/cm inv radius, linear color, unit direction/tangent, packed f16/unorm fields
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: TranslatedWorld (position already includes PreViewTranslation); direction/tangent unit vectors

fields.name: LightColorAndIdAndFalloffExponentAndRayEndBias
fields.decode: .x colorLength/1023; .y RGB10 color direction bits; .z float(LightSceneId), read as int; .w f16(FalloffExponent) low | f16(RayEndBias) high

fields.name: LightDirectionAndSceneInfoExtraDataPacked
fields.decode: .xyz unit direction; .w packed bits 0:8 shadowmask,8:3 lightingchannel,11:2 type,13 castshadow,14 hasLF,15:8 LF atlas idx,23 affectTranslucent,24 megaLight,25 clusteredDeferred,26 volShadow,27 transmission

fields.name: SpotAnglesAndSourceRadiusPacked
fields.decode: .xy SpotAngles; .z f16 SourceRadius | f16 SoftSourceRadius; .w f16 SourceLength | f16 VolumetricScatteringIntensity

fields.name: LightTangentAndIESDataAndSpecularScale
fields.decode: .xyz tangent; .w RGB10(SpecularScale, DiffuseScale, (IESAtlasIndex+1)/1023), bit30 specular-is-reciprocal, bit31 diffuse-is-reciprocal

fields.name: RectDataAndVirtualShadowMapIdOrPrevLocalLightIndex
fields.decode: .x RG16 RectAtlasUVOffset.xy; .y RG16 RectAtlasUVScale.xy; .z f16 BarnLength | unorm10 BarnCosAngle<<16 | 6-bit AtlasMaxLevel<<26; .w (VSMid+1)<<16 | (PrevLocalLightIndex+1)&0xFFFF

transforms.name: recordIndex
transforms.expression: float4 base = ForwardLightIndex * 6; field reads by element index InData0..5

mathTerms: Record is sizeof(FForwardLightData) = 6*FVector4f = 96 B (static_assert at LightGridInjection.cpp:1672; stride constant BasePassRendering.h:209).

IMPORTANT: the shader struct declaration order in LightData.ush:79-96 is NOT the buffer order; the authoritative mirror is the by-name assignment in GetForwardLightData_Internal (LightGridCommon.ush:164-189) which matches the C++ order.
Mega lights are the tail of a cell's light range: MegaLightsDataStartIndex = DataStartIndex + NumLights - NumMegaLights.
gaps: Sub-field packings (RGB10 color, RG16 f16 pairs) are documented from the shader unpackers in LightData.ush; no captured bytes were decoded to re-verify each value.
Valid lights = NumLocalLights; capture 6 float4 = 1 light.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 96-byte FLightSceneData record per GPU light id
resourceSchemas.units: absolute world position (double-float High/Low, cm), radii cm, unit direction/tangent, dimensionless scales
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: absolute world space (not translated world); reconstructed as High+Low

formatAlternatives: TPersistentByteAddressBuffer<FLightSceneData>; capture descriptor stride 4 is the raw dword view

transforms.name: recordLoad
transforms.expression: Offset = LightId*96; fields loaded in order (the Load<FLightSceneData> shortcut is #if 0)

mathTerms: SIZEOF_LIGHT_SCENE_DATA = 96 (LightSceneData.h:91); capture 24576 B / 96 = 256 records = InitialBufferSize.
Indexed by GPU light id (0..NumGPULights-1).
gaps: Capture reports stride 4/6144 elements because it is a byte-address buffer descriptor; the logical record stride is 96.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 240-byte FLightmapSceneShaderData record per lightmap slot (15 float4)
resourceSchemas.units: lightmap UV scale/bias, SH coefficients, virtual-texture packed uniforms; no world coordinate space
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: lightmap UV / packed VT uniform space

formatAlternatives: bound as StructuredBuffer<float4>; capture 61440 B / 240 = 256 records

transforms.name: recordIndex
transforms.expression: record r occupies float4 slots [r*15, r*15+15)

mathTerms: LIGHTMAP_SCENE_DATA_STRIDE = 15 float4 = 240 B (LightmapData.ush:50).
The captured NumElements 134217728 (2^27) is a bogus descriptor-size artifact; 61440 B / 240 = 256 records is consistent with the 256-record initial allocation.
gaps: Live new-record count is not recoverable from this capture (bogus element count); only the 256-record capacity arithmetic is exact.
Field offsets are source-order from FLightmapSceneShaderData::Setup and the 15x float4 stride; no explicit pack site exists.

resourceSchemas.quantity: two uint32 header words per light-grid cell (lights half) and two per reflection-capture cell (second half)
resourceSchemas.units: header0: light and megaliight counts; header1: 30-bit data start index plus 2 flag bits
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: light-grid/froxel cell index: index=(z*CulledGridSize.y+y)*CulledGridSize.x+x with z from log2 depth

fields.name: Header1
fields.decode: bit31 bHasTexturedLight, bit30 bHasRectLight, bits0-29 DataStartIndex; reflection cells: plain DataStartIndex

transforms.name: cellIndex
transforms.expression: x=Px>>6; y=Py>>6; z=clamp(uint(max(0,log2(Depth*B+O)*S)),0,GridSizeZ-1); index=(z*GridSizeY+y)*GridSizeX+x; stereo eye1 index += MaxNumCells

mathTerms: Cell c occupies 2 consecutive uint32 at byte offset 8*c (NUM_CULLED_LIGHTS_GRID_STRIDE=2); the two field entries above describe one cell.
Grid: GLightGridPixelSize=64, GLightGridSizeZ=32, Z distribution scale S=4.05.
MaxNumCells=17920 in capture = maxGridXY*32*2 (already includes the two primitive types); buffer words = MaxNumCells*2.
Mega lights are the tail of each cell's run.
gaps: Actual CulledGridSize.xy is a runtime uniform; the 35840-word capacity only bounds max grid XY <= 280.
Capture 35840 words implies MaxNumCells=17920; NumGridCells may be smaller.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 60-byte FLightViewData per GPU light id
resourceSchemas.units: translated-world position cm, linear color, dimensionless intensity/UV/atlas fields
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: TranslatedWorld for position; UV space for rect-atlas fields

formatAlternatives: sizeof(FLightViewData)=60, used directly as the RDG stride

transforms.name: stereoOffset
transforms.expression: secondary eye adds PreViewTranslationOffsetISR.xyz to TranslatedWorldPosition

mathTerms: Shared C++/HLSL header gives the layout; sizeof 60 matches the captured stride.
Indexed by LightSceneId.GetIndex().
gaps: Offsets are source-order derived (no compiled reflection dump), cross-checked only by the 60-byte stride.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float per forward light: dimensionless previous/current estimated light-power ratio
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none; indexed by ForwardLightIndex (same indexing as ForwardLightBuffer)

formatAlternatives: RWBuffer<float>; cleared to 1.0 when history is disabled

mathTerms: LightPower = ComputeLightPower(LightData)*View.PreExposure; HistoryPreExposureCorrection = PreExposure/PrevSceneColorPreExposure.
NumForwardLights = max(NumLocalLights+NumDirectionalLights,1).
gaps: Per-view buffer; capture has 1 valid float.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-view hierarchical depth pyramid; HZBClosest stores the max (nearest) device Z, HZBFurthest stores the min (farthest) device Z of each 2x2 depth quad
resourceSchemas.units: device Z in [0,1] (reversed Z: larger = nearer; 0 = far plane)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: HZB texture UV [0,1] over HZBSize(mip0); viewport -> HZB scales by ViewRect.Size()/(2*HZBSize)

fields.name: ClosestDeviceZ
fields.decode: RoundUpF16(max of the 2x2 device-Z quad); rounding up keeps the closest occluder conservative

transforms.name: mipReduce
transforms.expression: mip m = 2x2 reduction of mip m-1; HZBSize=max(pow2(ViewRect)/2,1); NumMips=max(floor(log2(max(HZBSize))),1); footprint mip = log2(footprint)

mathTerms: Reversed Z: min DeviceZ = furthest surface, max DeviceZ = closest (HZB.usf:277-282).
Capture 1048576 B = base mip 1024x512x2; full 10-mip chain is larger, so the descriptor byte count covers mip0 only.
ClosestDeviceZ = f16(maxZ)+1 (next FP16) so the tested nearest occluder is conservative.
gaps: Exact view extent is not in ResourceDescs metadata; 1024x512 is derived from the captured byte count and HZBSize=pow2/2.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-view hierarchical depth pyramid of the *minimum* (farthest) device Z over each 2x2 depth quad and over all children
resourceSchemas.units: device Z in [0,1] (reversed Z: larger = nearer; 0 = far plane)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: HZB texture UV [0,1] over HZBSize(mip0); viewport -> HZB scales by ViewRect.Size()/(2*HZBSize)

fields.name: FurthestDeviceZ
fields.decode: min of the 2x2 device-Z quad; mip m = min of the four children; no FP16 rounding-up

transforms.name: mipReduce
transforms.expression: mip m = min over the 2x2 children of mip m-1; HZBSize=max(pow2(ViewRect)/2,1); NumMips=max(floor(log2(max(HZBSize))),1)

mathTerms: Reversed Z: min DeviceZ = furthest surface (HZB.usf:256,277).
CS path can also fold VisBuffer depth before the reduce (HZB.usf:250-253).
Capture 1048576 B = base mip 1024x512x2; the full mip chain is larger, so the descriptor byte count covers mip0 only.
gaps: Exact view extent is not in ResourceDescs metadata; 1024x512 is derived from the captured byte count and HZBSize=pow2/2.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 2D atlas of 16 slots (default 4x4 grid) of 128x128 light-function intensity
resourceSchemas.units: UNORM light-function color in [0,1]; shader squares it (gamma-ish decode)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: atlas UV [0,1]; per-slot UV = MinUV + saturate(LightFunctionUV)*Slot_UVSize

fields.name: LightFunctionValue
fields.decode: tex.r (or .rgb when colored); value*value used as light-function factor

mathTerms: AtlasResolution = SlotResolution*EdgeSize; defaults 128*4 = 512.
Slot_UVSize = 127/512 = 0.248046875 for defaults (half-texel inset).
gaps: Capture proves the default gray-scale format only.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 80-byte FAtlasLightInfoData record per light-function slot: 4 float4 parameters + a 4x4 float transform
resourceSchemas.units: fade distance (cm), packed light type/disabled brightness/atlas min UV, tan outer angle, translated-world->light matrix

fields.name: LightTypeAndDisabledBrightness
fields.decode: bits0-7 LightType; bits8-23 f16 Encoded LightFunctionDisabledBrightness; bits24-31 unused

mathTerms: The captured 160 float4 / 5 = 32 records; the effective capacity is roundUp(N,32).
Slot index 0 is reserved as the null light function (LightFunctionAtlasLightIndex==0 => none).
gaps: Captured element count is float4 count (160), not light count (32); valid record count is runtime (EffectiveLocalLightSlotArray.Num).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one HDR RGBA scene-color texel per viewport pixel (MSAA-resolved target)
resourceSchemas.units: linear RGB + alpha (alpha used only when propagate-alpha/holdout is on)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: viewport pixel space; ViewRect is the valid sub-rect of the quantized extent

formatAlternatives: forced PF_FloatRGBA when an alpha channel is required

mathTerms: Format selected by FSceneTexturesConfig::GetSceneColorFormat from r.SceneColorFormat (default 4) and bRequiresAlphaChannel.
gaps: Exact extent is not in ResourceDescs metadata; it is derived from the byte count.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one HDR RGB texel per viewport pixel: separate translucency composited over scene color after DOF

formatAlternatives: ComposeToNew falls back to input SceneColor format when OutputPixelFormat is PF_Unknown

fields.name: RGB
fields.decode: linear scene color after translucency composition

mathTerms: Capture 4546560 B / 4 = 1136640 texels = full-res viewport; format proves the ComposeToNewSceneColor path with R11G11B10 output.
OutputViewport = FScreenPassTextureViewport(SceneColorSlice).
gaps: Which producer path is inferable from the format only; the exact blend operation is not encoded in the resource.

resourceSchemas.quantity: half-resolution copy of scene color (2x2 box/filtered downsample) used by local exposure, histogram and bloom
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: downsampled viewport pixel space; dstRect.Min=srcRect.Min/2, dstRect.Max=ceil(srcRect.Max/2)

formatAlternatives: format is never inherited on this pass: DownsampleOverrideFormat=PF_FloatRGB unconditionally

transforms.name: downscale
transforms.expression: dstExtent = ceil(srcExtent/2) per axis (min 1); rect min/2, rect max=ceil(max/2)

mathTerms: Capture 1136640 B / 4 = 284160 texels = exactly 1/4 of 1136640.
Low quality = one bilinear 2x2 tap; High quality = 4 taps at +/-1 input texel.
gaps: Rect vs extent: texture extent may exceed the valid rect by the ceil rule.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float32 device Z per screen pixel from the previous frame (opaque/front-layer depth)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: screen pixel; sampled via reprojected history UV, clamped to HistoryUVMinMax

fields.name: DeviceZ
fields.decode: Material.DeviceZ written unfiltered; consumer converts device Z to world depth for comparison

transforms.name: historyReproject
transforms.expression: HistoryUV = SvPosition*HistoryScreenPositionScaleBias + HistoryScreenPositionScaleBias.wz, clamped; depth reject if history depth is in front

mathTerms: Full viewport extent; capture 4546560 B / 4 = 1136640 texels.
History validity also requires bHistoryWasOnScreen and normal tests.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint2 per screen pixel: 16-bit encoded previous-frame screen X and Y
resourceSchemas.units: fixed-point history pixel coordinate with sub-pixel bits

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: Pixel = Encode >> DecodeShift; SubPixel = Encode - (Pixel<<DecodeShift); Weight = SubPixel * InvSubPixelGridSize

mathTerms: Codec: SubPixelGridSize = floor(65535/extent); DecodeShift = floor(log2(grid)); grid = 1<<shift (StochasticLighting.cpp:61-75).
Not velocity; a reprojected screen coordinate with sub-pixel precision.
gaps: Exact DecodeShift depends on the viewport extent, which is not in ResourceDescs metadata.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint8 of Lumen stochastic-sampling flags per screen pixel per closure slice
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: screen pixel x closure slice (2D array)

formatAlternatives: ArraySize = closure count (1 in legacy-substrate capture)

fields.name: bCanReconstruct
fields.decode: bit6: stochastic sample can be reconstructed (HasValidStochasticSample)

mathTerms: Bit layout is exclusive to Lumen; MegaLights reuses the same 8-bit struct with different bit4-7 semantics (FMegaLightsPackedPixelData) - do not cross-apply.
Invalid pixels keep the 0x30 sentinel.
gaps: Capture array size is 1 (legacy substrate); a substrate build has one slice per closure.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint8 bitmask per 8x8-pixel tile per closure slice
resourceSchemas.units: bit flags OR-ed over the tile's pixels
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: tile space: tile = SvPosition/8; array [uint3(TileCoord, ClosureIndex)]

formatAlternatives: extent = ceil(Config.Extent/8) per axis; ArraySize=closure count

transforms.name: tileIndex
transforms.expression: tile = SvPosition >> 3; mask |= per-pixel bit; final = BitFieldExtract(groupMask,10,0)

mathTerms: Tile size 8x8 (StochasticLighting.cpp:31).
Shared-memory reduction reserves 10 bits per subsystem (Lumen/MegaLights/Substrate at 0/10/20); only the low 8 bits survive the R8 store, lossless because Lumen uses <=0x0F.
Capture 17760 bytes = 17760 tiles (e.g. 160x111 or 240x74), 1 slice.
gaps: Exact tile grid depends on the viewport extent, not in ResourceDescs metadata.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one packed world normal + 2 flag bits per screen pixel from the previous frame
resourceSchemas.units: 10:10:10 UNORM normal (world, unit) + 2 flag bits in alpha
mathTerms: 2-bit alpha is stored mid-bucket: a=(flags+0.5)/4 so each code decodes robustly.
World-space normal is also used for position bias.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one bit per forward-light index indicating the light is batched for this translucency volume cascade; stored in 32-bit words
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: forward light index space; one buffer per volume cascade (TVC_MAX=2)

formatAlternatives: NumElements = ceil(MaxBatchedLocalLights/32) words; capture 1 word = 32 light slots

fields.name: LightBit
fields.decode: bit i set => forward light index 32*w+i is batched; consumer iterates firstbitlow and clears

mathTerms: LSB-first bit order (TBitArray).
MaxBatchedLocalLights is padded to a multiple of 32 before upload; padded bits are 0.
gaps: Valid light count (<=32 in capture) is a uniform, not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 3-float4 per-(asset,reversed-mip) record; a full asset slot is 9 float4 = 144 B (3 mips x 3 float4)
resourceSchemas.units: mixed: indirection dimensions in indirection voxels; IndirectionTableOffset in uint32 entries; VolumeToIndirection affine in volume->indirection-voxel units; DistanceFieldToVolumeScaleBias in volume units per UNORM
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: per-mip virtual indirection space derived from normalized mesh volume space (mesh bounds scaled so the max extent maps to [-1,1])

formatAlternatives: forced 16-byte structured stride; logical per-(asset,mip) record is 48 B and per-asset slot 144 B

fields.name: Vector0.x
fields.decode: low10 IndirectionDimensions.x, next10 .y, next10 .z, top2 NumMips

mathTerms: DistanceField::NumMips=3, AssetDataMipStrideFloat4s=3, DF_ASSET_DATA_STRIDE=9.
Indirection dimensions are 10 bits each, cap 1024; NumMips is 2 bits (top of word0).
Hand packed: C++ writes IntVector0[0..3] and the HLSL loader reads word0/1/2; there is no mirrored C++ struct or static_assert.
gaps: No GPU live count: dead asset slots have NumMips==0; the capture 144 B is one asset slot of capacity, not a count of live mips.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 48-byte per-object bounds record (3 float4): world center high/low, sphere radius, AABB extent, 6 flags
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: absolute world space stored as double-float High/Low; consumers subtract ViewOrigin to get translated world

fields.name: Flags
fields.decode: bits0 OftenMoving,1 CastShadow,2 IsNaniteMesh,3 EmissiveLightSource,4 Visible,5 AffectIndirectLightingWhileHidden

transforms.name: center
transforms.expression: CenterWorld = PositionHigh + PositionLow; TranslatedCenter = DFFastToTranslatedWorld(Center, PreViewTranslation)

mathTerms: 3 float4 per object; bounds are primitive world bounds (center from PrimAndInst.Origin + WorldBoundsRelativeToOrigin, extent = GetExtent()).
Flags are packed from C++ booleans; only 6 bits used.
gaps: Word0.w is written but unused; live object count is NumObjectsInBuffer (uniform), not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 160-byte per-object record (10 float4): position high, world<->volume affine matrices, volume extent/bias, draw distances, GPU instance index, volume scale, asset index
resourceSchemas.units: volume space is dimensionless (max mesh extent maps to [-1,1]); VolumeToWorldScale is cm per volume unit; SelfShadowBias is world cm (converted by 1/max(VolumeToWorldScale) at DistanceFieldShadowingShared.ush:121); MinMaxDrawDistance2 is cm^2
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: volume space = mesh local space scaled by 1/max(extent); matrices relative to translated world

fields.name: PositionHigh
fields.decode: PreTranslation of the FDF inverse matrix

mathTerms: 10 float4 = 160 B per object; VolumeScale is derived as min(VolumeToWorldScale.xyz) and is not stored.
HLSL FDFObjectData declaration order is NOT the buffer layout; readers use explicit word indices.
SelfShadowBias is converted to volume units by 1/max(VolumeToWorldScale) in the shadowing shader.
gaps: bMostlyTwoSided is encoded only as the sign of word4.w; if ExpandSurfaceDistance==0 the bit would be lost (not guarded).
Live object count is NumObjectsInBuffer (uniform), not stored.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint32 per asset slot: desired number of loaded mips (1..3; 0 = no request)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: asset-slot index space (sparse-set asset id), not spatial

fields.name: WantedNumMips
fields.decode: cleared to 1; InterlockedMax with 2/3 when the object AABB intersects mip1/mip2 extents

mathTerms: Producer: ComputeDistanceFieldAssetWantedMipsCS; consumer: GenerateDistanceFieldAssetStreamingRequestsCS requests when WantedNumMips!=0 && NumMips!=0 && NumMips!=Wanted.
DistanceField::NumMips=3.
gaps: Live asset count is the NumDistanceFieldAssets shader uniform, not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: element 0 = record count N, then N records of 2 uint32 {AssetIndex, WantedNumMips}; capacity MaxStreamingRequests*2+1
resourceSchemas.units: asset id and mip count; header is a record count

transforms.name: recordAddress
transforms.expression: AssetIndex = buf[1+2*i]; WantedNumMips = buf[2+2*i]; i < min(buf[0],4095)

mathTerms: In 5.8.1 this buffer has exactly ONE record shape (asset mip requests); there is no type tag and no DF-object request branch. DF object add/remove is CPU-driven.
The producer increments the header before the capacity check, so the header can overcount dropped records; the record write is guarded by index<4095.
gaps: The task-level premise of two request kinds (asset mip + DF object) is false for this engine version; no such branch exists in source.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint4 per (GDF page, 3D cell): four candidate object slots, each a packed 24-bit GPUSceneInstanceIndex + 8-bit normalized distance
resourceSchemas.units: per slot: 24-bit instance index and 8-bit normalized distance code; cell world size derives from ClipmapVoxelExtent (cm)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: GDF page-grid cell space: cell offset = ZOrder3DEncode(coord,2) in 0..63; buffer index = 64*Page.PageIndex + cellOffset
mathTerms: MaxQueryDistance = 1.44*CellWorldExtent + 3*ClipmapVoxelExtent; CellWorldExtent = ClipmapVoxelExtent*7/4.
Entries are insertion-sorted ascending so smaller packed distance (nearest) comes first; AddToObjectGridCell replaces the current max only when the new value is smaller.
Consumer iterates 4 slots and breaks at the first 0xFFFFFFFF.
gaps: Producer has no bounds check on Page.PageIndex (relies on the page allocator); MaxPageNum is runtime (capture implies 114688 = 128*128*7 pages).
The 8-bit distance is decoded by the pack formula but the Lumen consumer ignores it (uses only the instance index); inverse decode is lossy.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 64 uint32 stats slots; only slots 0..2 are written (valid-page count, empty-page count, updated-page count)

fields.name: Combi
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per valid page across clipmaps

fields.name: Empty
fields.decode: per valid page with no interior sample strictly between 0 and 1

mathTerms: GLOBAL_DISTANCE_FIELD_PAGE_GROUP_NUM = (8/4)^3 = 8.
Purely debug counters (bound only by GlobalDistanceFieldDebugCS); cleared each frame.
